transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before I sign Thursday's airlift manifest, I need to confirm whether operations, signal, and medical have any changes to their standard pallet requests. As a reminder, the contracted aircraft has capacity for exactly 23 pallets. Our normal weekly request is 18 pallets total — 8 engineering, 5 communications batteries, and 5 medical — which leaves us 5 unused spaces. If anyone has changes to their requirements this week, please report them now so I can finalize the manifest and loading instructions.
